skill_drafts.name: Dataset trace filtering and preparation
skill_drafts.description: Filter and prepare cache trace datasets by excluding traces below a minimum request threshold and normalizing trace length metrics for cache eviction analysis.
skill_drafts.objective: Prepare clean, normalized trace datasets for cache algorithm evaluation
applicable_signals: Evaluating cache eviction algorithms on historical trace data
Need to exclude sparse or incomplete traces before benchmarking
Preparing datasets for cache performance comparison studies
contraindications: Working with real-time streaming cache data
workflow_steps: Filter: exclude traces with < 1 million requests
Normalize: convert trace length to object fraction metric
Validate: confirm all remaining traces meet criteria
Output: return filtered, normalized dataset collection
triggers: Evaluating cache eviction algorithms on historical trace data; need to exclude sparse or incomplete traces before benchmarking
constraints: Minimum request threshold: 1 million requests per trace
Trace length must be expressible as fraction of objects in trace
output_contract: Filtered dataset collection with all traces meeting minimum request count (≥1 million); trace length normalized to object fraction metric; ready for cache algorithm benchmarking

metadata.prompt:
Apply the following steps to prepare trace datasets for cache algorithm evaluation:
1. Load candidate trace dataset collection.
2. Filter out any trace with fewer than 1 million requests.
3. Normalize trace length metric: express as fraction of unique objects in the trace.
4. Retain only filtered, normalized traces for downstream benchmarking.
Output the cleaned dataset collection ready for cache eviction algorithm testing.
